title: The Quarantine Risk Pool
logline: When a health insurance syndicate threatens to cancel life-support coverage for an infected habitat, a doctor and a blockade runner clash over diverted oxygen filters.

roles.description: Oversees the mutual risk pool; coldly calculates survivor ratios while threatening to drop delinquent sectors.
Runs the habitat infirmary; desperate for clean oxygen scrubbers to keep quarantined wards alive.
A modified patrol interceptor converted into an armed blockade runner by desperate dockers.
A sealed orbital cylinder under red bio-hazard beacon warning.
A consortium of pharmaceutical suppliers and underwriters demanding exorbitant risk premiums.

public_situation: Underwriters in {system} threaten to terminate life-support insurance policies for {role:quarantine_habitat} unless delinquent premium riders are settled.
private_truth: {role:pool_administrator} is deliberately withholding filter shipments to trigger an automated default clause that transfers habitat docking bays to corporate creditors.

beats.public_change: Hazard beacons flash amber around {role:quarantine_habitat} as scrubber failure alarms sound across the outer ring.

missions.reason: The doctor hires the pilot to purchase industrial molecular filters from an unsealed trade hub and deliver them before life-support reserves fail.
missions.private_fact: The doctor has already pawned personal medical licenses to raise the cash for the filter down-payment.

beats.public_change: Blockade runners set up an armed perimeter around the habitat's central intake manifold.

missions.reason: The administrator pays the pilot to destroy an unauthorized blockade interceptor harassing inbound commercial delivery shuttles.
missions.private_fact: The interceptor skipper hails mid-fight offering to surrender seized corporate scrip if the pilot diverts filters to the lower ward children.

beats.public_change: {role:pool_administrator} docks at the main airlock to deliver an eviction writ and cancel atmospheric indemnity.

missions.reason: The doctor needs the authenticated emergency medical audit carried directly to the habitat council chamber before the administrator cuts power.
missions.private_fact: The audit proves habitat infection rates dropped ten percent, proving the quarantine cancellation is medically unwarranted.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot stands at the airlock with the medical audit while the administrator prepares to disconnect habitat power loops.

options.label: Present the medical audit publicly to force the consortium to maintain life-support indemnity across all wards
Help the administrator seize the habitat's commercial slips in exchange for guaranteed oxygen for the upper ward
Encourage the dockers to seize the consortium intake pumps and declare complete defiance of quarantine bylaws

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot reveals the audit and forces policy reinstatement.
resolutions.summary: {role:medical_consortium} is forced to reinstate full life-support coverage; {role:pool_administrator} is recalled in disgrace and the wards stabilize.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot forced an underwriting syndicate to restore life-support policies to a quarantined habitat.

resolutions.reached_by: The administrator seizes docking slips in exchange for upper-ward oxygen.
resolutions.summary: {role:medical_consortium} assumes ownership of habitat docking slips; upper decks receive premium filters while lower deckers face eviction.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the raider deal and routes filters to lower decks.
resolutions.summary: Lower deck wards receive lifesaving scrubbers; {role:pool_administrator} cancels habitat policies in retaliation, turning the station into an armed commune.

resolutions.reached_by: The dockers seize the intake manifold and defy corporate regulations.
resolutions.summary: Habitat dockers take armed control of atmospheric controls, breaking corporate contracts and prompting a full military blockade of {system}.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot abandons contracts or medical supplies are lost.
resolutions.summary: Underwriters void the risk pool; atmospheric scrubbers shut down across {role:quarantine_habitat}, forcing a chaotic emergency evacuation into deep space.

loose_threads.detail: Risk pool premium rates jumped fourfold twelve hours before the official quarantine outbreak notice was published.
The medical filter crates carry an inspector approval stamp from a doctor who died during last year's pandemic.

radio_hooks: {role:quarantine_habitat} faces imminent life-support shutdown over disputed risk pool premiums.
Medical consortium warns against unauthorized filter deliveries to quarantined sectors.
Infirmary staff in {system} plead for emergency air scrubbers as infection rate peaks.

voice_direction.pool_administrator: Cold, clipped, reciting actuarial mortality probabilities as though reporting weather trends.
voice_direction.station_doctor: Exhausted, hoarse, speaking in short, breathy sentences while pleading for supplies.
